n: Green bus route 184 Main Bus Station - Yas Island
الباص الأخضر خط 184 المحطة الرئيسية - جزيرة ياس
no: Low-emission bus route run with hydrogen and electric buses. Timetable on the Darbi website. Phone 800850 is the Abu Dhabi Mobility contact centre (lost property, fine appeals); the same site lists 800555 as the unified support centre.

خط حافلات صديق للبيئة يعمل بحافلات تعمل بالهيدروجين والكهرباء. الجدول على موقع دربي. الرقم 800850 هو مركز اتصال أبوظبي للتنقل (المفقودات والتظلم من المخالفات)، ويذكر الموقع نفسه الرقم 800555 كمركز دعم الخدمات الموحد.

n: Service 73 Al Reem Island - Al Hudayriyat Island
no: Bus with a dedicated bike space, linking Al Reem Island and Al Hudayriyat Island via main city landmarks. Timetable on the Darbi website. Phone 800850 is the Abu Dhabi Mobility contact centre (lost property, fine appeals); the same site lists 800555 as the unified support centre.

n: H04 Hatta Hop On Hop Off
no: Circular route from Hatta Bus Station via Hatta Wadi Hub, Hatta Hill Park, Hatta Dam and the Heritage Village. AED 2 per person per stop.

n: Sharjah bus 14: Al Sharq - Sharjah Airport
no: Sharjah city bus run by Mowasalat/KGL under Sharjah RTA supervision. Mowasalat lists ticket prices of AED 9 (cash) and AED 7 (Sayer card). Maps and live times on mowasalat.ae and the Rihlati trip planner.
